info.title: Cisco IOS-XE IETF - ietf-interfaces
info.description:
IETF standard data from `ietf-interfaces` module.

**Root containers:** 2 (interfaces, interfaces-state)
**Paths:** 36 | **Operations:** 60

Supports CRUD for read-write nodes, GET for read-only nodes.

get.description:
Retrieve interfaces from the device via RESTCONF.

Returns the current operational or configuration state of this resource.

put.description:
Create or replace interfaces on the device.

This replaces the entire resource — any fields not included will be removed.

patch.description:
Partially update interfaces on the device.

Only the fields included in the request body are modified; other fields remain unchanged.

delete.description:
Remove interfaces from the device configuration.

This deletes the resource and all descendant data.
